Appearance:
In general, Marisa is depicted with blonde hair and yellow eyes. She wears clothes with a black and white color scheme, consisting of a black vest and skirt, white waist apron and undershirt, and a black witch hat with a white bow. Her hair is commonly braided on one side with a bow on the end. She sometimes wears dark blue clothes instead, such as in Legacy of Lunatic Kingdom, Subterranean Animism, or the fighting game spin offs from Hopeless Masquerade onwards. She also has large breasts and wide hips.
 
Personality:
Marisa’s personality is outgoing and informal, being that she talks to most people in Gensokyo and is friendly to humans and non-humans. Although she’s cautious around youkai and will jump into action if she finds it interesting, which could lead her to danger.
She has a mad obsession for “permanently borrowing” magical items from people, though is good at hiding them. 
Marisa found a peculiar mushroom in the Forest of Magic.
She carries her magical broom and Mini-Hakkero around her and uses magic for exterminating youkais. 

Hobby/Occupation:
Magician, Kirisame Magic Shop owner, burglar (although she denies this by stating that she's "borrowing" said item that is being stolen), part-time youkai hunter

Additional Information: 
● Marisa has trained herself in magic that specialises in light and heat. She uses it for flashy youkai extermination more than anything. Her magic makes for a good danmaku show, but this is made possible only through her strenuous honest effort in creating layered effects. Most of her spells are themed after stars and other astronomical phenomena.

● She has a mania for collecting things and exhibits knowledge of various valuable and/or magical objects around Gensokyo. She frequently loots many places for various materials, particularly anything she finds interesting. That said, this habit does result in her forgetting what objects are in her house.

● She doesn’t have a specific nor officially stated occupation, but she does regularly go to the Hakurei Shrine to take away Reimu's youkai extermination jobs. She's also written a book called The Grimoire of Marisa that reviews various spell cards by different owners of a spell; she's shown a desire to try and sell the book. She has been shown to sell magic or lucky charms, the origin of these charms are dubious.

● Marisa is known to be somewhat of a burglar/thief, as she boldly breaks in from the front and openly says her motto "I'll be borrowing these!" while carrying things off. She mostly steals books, so she might not be the kind who steals money. This also might be the reason as how she can easily learn other people’s moves.

● Marisa uses her broom to fly, as part of her magician appearance. The broom was originally just a normal broom, but due to the constant exposure to magic, it caused major growth. It’s made of bamboo (although the bamboo is dead), with leaves sprouting out from the handle because of Marisa’s magic.

● The Mini-Hakkero is Marisa's treasured item. It is a furnace that she uses to power her signature Master Spark. From the flame of a table-top stove, to that of a flamethrower, to a powerful and unmatched wide magicannon, the mini-Hakkero has a convenient range of uses. Marisa herself said, "I can't even think of makin' a livin' without it."

● Marisa’s (most famous) signature spell card is Love Sign "Master Spark", a large laser she fires out using her Mini-Hakkero. 
Similar spell cards are Magicannon "Final Spark", Loving Heart "Double Spark", Love Sign "Master Spark-like Flashlight".
